Subject: APAC vendor setup: GST certificate + invoice formatting for PO activation

Hi Lucia,

Thanks again for agreeing to onboard Sunrise Logistics as a Redwood vendor. To get the PO and first payment scheduled we need a short set of documents from your side so Finance can complete the local tax validation in our APAC ledger. Could you please provide the following items?

- Official GST registration certificate or equivalent (scanned PDF) that shows your NZ GST number and registration date.
- Sample invoice that includes a clear VAT/GST line item (we need to confirm rate applied and whether it is stated separately). Ideally July or August 2025.
- Signed Redwood vendor onboarding form (I attached the DocuSign link below if easier).
- Bank remittance details and SWIFT/IBAN as applicable.

A couple of clarifying questions for your accounts team: do your invoices include GST when billing non-NZ customers under reverse charge rules, or do you issue zero-rated exports? If you have a standard note you put on export invoices, please include that.

If you can send the files by end of week our procurement team will create the PO and route to Monica in Finance for the final approval.

Appreciate it — I can jump on a quick 15-min call if that helps.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Partner Ops | Redwood Inference

- Bank details included on the onboarding form; our preferred currency is NZD but we can invoice in USD if Redwood prefers.

Hi Diego — thanks for sending. I reviewed the attachments. Quick answers below and a step list so we can get the PO live: 

1) GST registration: If Sunrise is zero-rating for exports, Redwood does not need to register in New Zealand for GST for standard service purchases. We only need to consider registration if:
   - Redwood establishes a fixed establishment in NZ, or
   - We have local taxable supplies above the NZ registration threshold (unlikely for a single vendor service).

2) PO tax handling: Create PO with tax code "APAC-EXP-ZERO" and include a note: "Supplier indicates export of services — zero-rated under NZ GST Act; supplier GST certificate on file." This will ensure accounting treats it as zero-rated. If Lucia later sends taxable invoices we will update the tax code.

3) Documentation: Attachments are sufficient for vendor creation. Please confirm bank details currency (NZD vs USD) before issuing the PO. If they prefer USD, set PO currency to USD and include FX note.

4) Withholding tax: NZ does not require withholding on standard service invoices to non-resident suppliers in this scenario. No action needed now.

Next steps (action owners):
- Diego: Confirm invoice currency with Sunrise and complete vendor profile (due EOD Thu).
- Monica: Once vendor is created I will provision the PO with tax code and route for approval.
- Priyom: Please add HubSpot company tag "APAC-vendor-onboard" for tracking.

Thanks — sounds straightforward. If either party wants a call, I can do 9:30am PT.

Monica Patel
Finance Manager, Payments | Redwood Inference
